title: What is stale data?
summary: Stale data means your RAG system retrieves outdated information instead of the latest approved information. Incorrect documents may also contain: - Wrong facts. - Duplicate policies. - Contradictory versions. - Incomplete updates. - Unapproved documents.
objectives: Explain every point in “What is stale data?” with clear language
Use the flow diagram to see what happens one step after another
Connect the visual flow to the written explanation and code

sections.title: Overview
sections.body:
Stale data means your RAG system retrieves outdated information instead of the latest approved information.

Incorrect documents may also contain:

- Wrong facts.
- Duplicate policies.
- Contradictory versions.
- Incomplete updates.
- Unapproved documents.

steps.label: Query
steps.narration: The user query enters the system and may need rewriting before search.

steps.label: Transform
steps.narration: Query transformation expands, rewrites, or decomposes the question to improve recall.

steps.label: Fuse
steps.narration: Fusion methods such as RRF combine rankings from multiple retrievers into one list.

steps.label: Rerank
steps.narration: A cross-encoder or LLM reranker reorders candidates for higher precision context.

steps.narration: Final context is budgeted, ordered, and injected into the prompt for grounded generation.
